body.lead: Destinations this process delivers its audit events to. A token and a secret header are sealed and never shown again. A test sends a synthetic event and does not record that synthetic event as an audit row.
body.thisProcess: The figures on this page are this process. Each process delivers its own audit events.
body.none: No audit export destination is configured.
body.name: Name
body.templateTip: Webhook only. One line. A placeholder is a name in braces, such as timestamp, severity, event_type, subject or message. Empty sends the event as JSON.
body.headersTip: Webhook only. One header a line, written as a name, a colon and a value. These are shown again on a change, and an empty box replaces them. A name that looks like a credential is stored as a secret header instead.
body.secretHeadersTip: Webhook only. One header a line, written as a name, a colon and a value. The value is sealed and is not shown again. An empty box keeps the stored headers. A blank value keeps that one name.
body.tokenKept: set — leave empty to keep it
